verification_report.summary: The submission does not prove the full stated result. The two supplied proofs—finite-flat continuity/current compatibility of the trace and the arbitrary-field disc argument—pass their local mathematical and citation checks conditional on the earlier rational-centred-traces proposition. However, no proof is supplied for either prop:p062-rational-centred-traces or prop:p062-explicit-base-change, and the disc proof relies essentially on the first of these omitted proofs. All five external citations checked were found to match and be applicable.

gaps.issue: No proof is supplied for the rational-centred radial identity or any of its open/closed polydisc constancy consequences.
No proof is supplied for any of the three base-change assertions, including the claimed automatic vanishing after scalar extension for approximation-psh h and -h.

gaps.location: Proof of prop:p062-arbitrary-field-disc, application of prop:p062-rational-centred-traces
gaps.issue: The equalities H(ξ_q)=H(0) and h(η_t)=h(0) are obtained by invoking prop:p062-rational-centred-traces, but that indispensable proposition has no proof anywhere in the submission.

repair_hints: Supply a complete, independent proof of prop:p062-rational-centred-traces (for both open and closed polydiscs, including the endpoint and constancy consequences) before it is used in the disc argument. Supply proofs of all three items of prop:p062-explicit-base-change: justify constancy upstairs from the rational-centred result and density over an algebraically closed extension, descend through the scalar-extension projection, and prove that approximation-psh is preserved by base change and that positivity for both h_L and -h_L forces d'd''[h_L]=0. Once the first omitted proposition is established, re-check the two invocations in the disc proof.
